Step 1Prepare Templates

  • 1. For each sample, pipette 100µL of TE + Triton X-100 into a PCR tube.
  • 2. Resuspend an isolated colony into each tube and pipette mix until completely suspended.
  • 3. Heat tubes in thermal cycler to 98°C for 10 min with heated lid.
  • 4. Briefly spin tubes using PCR tube centrifuge.
  • 5. Place tubes on ice until used (must use within several hours).

Step 2Prepare Reagents

  • 1. Thaw buffer and dNTPs.
  • 2. Prepare 10µM stocks of each primer in nuclease-free water.
  • 3. Vortex buffer, nucleotides and primers, then keep on ice.

Keep polymerase in freezer until just before use — never vortex polymerase.

  • 2. Vortex to mix.
  • 3. Add polymerase.

Step 4Aliquot Master Mix into Tubes

  • 1. Mix master mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down or pulse vortexing.
  • 2. Pipette 19µL into 4 PCR tubes.
